talk_track.claim: “HP's MJF 1200 is under $60,000, professional printing within reach.”
talk_track.counter: It does not ship until early 2027. The Early Access program takes no payment and no commitment, which means nothing is actually reserved. Ask what they are running in the eighteen months in between.

talk_track.claim: “HP's IF 600 HT is open materials, no lock-in.”
talk_track.counter: Open materials also means unvalidated materials. Ask who certifies the process for their application, and who they call when a build fails qualification.

talk_track.claim: “HP is the drone additive manufacturing leader.”
talk_track.counter: HP names three drone customers in its advertising: Blueflite, Unusual Machines, Firestorm Labs. That is a proof set, not a market. Ask for production volumes.

talk_track.claim: “HP is everywhere in additive right now.”
talk_track.counter: HP runs 18 creatives on one platform, LinkedIn, and zero on Meta. Its April teaser and February booth ad were still live in August. That is a narrow, under-maintained program, not omnipresence.

exposure: Production system and scale messaging. HP's “building a production system the business can trust” is Stratasys core ground and they are now advertising on it.
Industrial filament. The IF 600 HT overlaps Stratasys FDM directly and HP has moved from announcing it to handling objections about it.
Drone and UAV share of voice. HP holds 14 of 36 live instances on drones. Our Drone Dominance program is contesting the same feed.
